newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices poised to continue upward march.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices poised to continue upward march.

text.p: Danish bond prices opened higher on Wednesday with dealers predicting another positive day ahead with palpable gains seen after Tuesday's better than expected U.S. March CPI data.
"We are optimistic about the market prospects for today. The positive undertone attracts investors buyers so we should continue up," one dealer said.
The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 opened 0.34 point up from Tuesday's close at 109.72. The 10-year yield gap with Germany narrowed one basis point to 71.
The crown opened at 3.8087 per mark, weakening slightly from 3.8080 at Tuesday's close. --Stig Pedersen, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969659
